visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left (Birth/Emergence): The adult cicada pulling itself out of its brown, crunchy nymph shell on a tree trunk; Top-Right (Dining): The cicada using its needle-like beak to sip sap from a branch; Bottom-Left (Sleeping): Motionless on the underside of a thick leaf; Bottom-Right (Activity/Singing): The cicada's abdomen vibrating rapidly as it lets out its iconic Cretaceous buzz.
visual_logic.style_notes: The 'Emergence' quadrant should highlight the contrast between the dull brown shell and the soft, fresh green/blue of the new adult body.
